prompt:
Ashen Spire shared art family ashen-spire-painted-v1. Tactile hand-painted realistic medieval fantasy, weathered matte stone/timber/rock and subdued natural colors, broad controlled detail, subtle material edges, no heavy cartoon outline, glossy toy rendering or photographic sparkle. Low ground-level player-height near-frontal camera with mild three-quarter perspective, NEVER elevated/isometric map-icon camera. This is an INSIDE-THE-LOCATION layered combat scene. Subject: one low village cottage facade with stone chimney and short fence section attached near its side. Role: One complete transparent near-side framing prop, near-frontal mild3quarter view toward street center on LEFT. Request1536square, object central75%, generous alpha margins, fully visible and no terrain slab. Entire roof, walls and base silhouette contained inside the canvas with transparent margins on all sides. A facade component only, not a miniature whole settlement or floating terrain diorama. Upright player-height view, with visible facade planes. CRITICAL: entire roof eaves must end comfortably inside canvas, absolutely no solid part touching any canvas border. Scale subject to 70% of square canvas width and height, with 15% empty transparent padding all four sides. Humble low cottage, attached short fence. Full silhouette.
processing: Byte-identical original imagegen output; no pixel editing, resizing, trimming or upscaling.
